rows.label: Demo Switch A
rows.help: Test row. Does nothing in the game; its value is stored in the shared settings band (record 0, bit 4).

rows.label: Demo Level
rows.help: Test row with three options. Does nothing in the game; its value is stored in the shared settings band (record 0, bits 5-6).

rows.label: Demo Switch B
rows.help: Test row. Does nothing in the game; its value is stored in the shared settings band (record 0, bit 7).
